# Non-production, excluded and Identity operations

Every operation in a definition that is not a Trimble Connect production API or another product's reference API:

- Trimble Connect staging, integration, QA, test, draft, internal or empty definitions. `variant` operations are the same call as the production operation they name; `excluded` operations exist only outside production or in Trimble-internal APIs.
- Definitions that Trimble marks as internal (App Xchange connector definitions), push or webhook contracts that the customer implements, and definitions that are undocumented, deprecated, credential-only or placeholders.
- Trimble Identity endpoints, which carry credentials and are never agent-callable.

Definitions with many operations are listed on their own page, linked from their section.

## trimble-identity (identity)

Endpoints from the OpenID Connect discovery document. The bridge's own sign-in (internal/identity, trimblectl auth) uses authorize, token and revoke; agents never call Identity endpoints because they carry credentials. 9 operations. Definition: [trimble-identity](https://id.trimble.com/.well-known/openid-configuration).

| Method | Path | Disposition | Detail |
|---|---|---|---|
| `POST` | `/oauth/token` | `excluded` | mutual-TLS token endpoint for confidential clients; the bridge is a public client |
| `GET` | `/.well-known/jwks.json` | `excluded` | public keys for validating Trimble-issued tokens; infrastructure, not a data API |
| `GET` | `/.well-known/openid-configuration` | `excluded` | discovery metadata; the source of this list, not a data API |
| `GET` | `/oauth/authorize` | `excluded` | browser sign-in redirect; used only by `trimblectl auth login` (authorization code with PKCE S256). Agents never handle credentials |
| `GET` | `/oauth/logout` | `excluded` | browser sign-out redirect; not used by the bridge or agents |
| `GET` | `/oauth/userinfo` | `excluded` | returns the signed-in user's personal profile; the bridge does not need it (data minimisation) |
| `POST` | `/oauth/device_authorization` | `excluded` | device-code grant; the bridge uses authorization code with PKCE instead |
| `POST` | `/oauth/revoke` | `excluded` | revokes tokens; used only by `trimblectl auth logout` |
| `POST` | `/oauth/token` | `excluded` | issues and refreshes tokens; used only by internal/identity (Serial PKCE). Agents never handle credentials |
